relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Follow-up studies showed that intravenous infusion of CGRP triggers migraine-like headaches preferentially in patients with migraine compared to healthy controls

relationships.subject: gepants
relationships.evidence_quote: The gepants are small molecules that block the CGRP receptor.

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Erenumab, fremanezumab, galcanezumab, and eptinezumab showed higher proportions of patients with ≥50% reduction in monthly migraine days relative to placebo for individuals with either EM or CM [37].

key_findings: CGRP-pathway monoclonal antibodies (incl. galcanezumab) and gepants are effective for migraine prevention/acute treatment.
